title: Ensuring Safe and High-Quality Outputs: A Guideline Library Approach for Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Models using benchmarks such as HHH (Helpful, Honest, Harmless), which are explicit ethical frameworks for AI behavior. It also includes specific guidelines for 'Promoting Ethical Behavior' and compares model responses based on a 'utilitarian outlook', demonstrating a core focus on moral and ethical alignment.
